title: Product Manager
description:
Overview

About Certara

Certara ’s purpose is to assist in accelerating the development of meaningful medicines that make an impact on our society and the people that need them most. Our portfolio spans the discovery, preclinical, clinical, and post-marketing phases of drug development, working with over 1200 commercial companies, 250 academic institutions, and numerous regulatory agencies.
About Certara Data Sciences Team
We build software solutions for scientists. Certara ’s data science software enables companies to use data as effectively as possible at every point in the process. With our industry-leading products, researchers can manage, visualize, and interact with data. Scientists are freed from tedious data processing and can focus on their core task - making confident decisions for the benefit of patients. Within the team, innovation and creativity are highly valued, and everyone is given the opportunity for training and continuous development.
About the Role
As a Product Manager, you will deliver value to our customers through improvements to our applications. Specifically, you will be responsible for the development and successful adoption of our applications by our customers. You will be working at the intersection of multiple teams that include user experience, subject matter experts, engineering, and marketing.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities
Customer Understanding & Advocacy

• Engage with our SMEs and customers to deeply understand data workflows and pain points.

• Establish trusted customer relationships.

• Collect customer insights and create actionable product ideas.
Product Strategy & Vision

• Identify and validate recurring customer problems that represent market opportunities and align with organizational capabilities.

• Understand the competitive landscape and be able to talk about strengths and weaknesses of our competition.

• Have broad awareness of the Certara Data Science portfolio to optimize software building.
Product Management

• Guide product lifecycle from ideation to development to go-to-market to scaled product-market-fit - ensuring successful execution of all steps.

• Build roadmap that aligns with our application’s vision and strategy.

• Partner with sales and customer success teams to ensure successful outcomes for our customers.

• Translate product vision and strategy into reasoned software priorities.

• Understand the personas of customers, and how each persona engages with our software.

• Ensure customer requirements are met with enterprise grade capabilities in performance, scalability, and reliability; authentication; access control; and software validation and compliance.

Qualifications

Others in this role have:

• BS/BA in science or technology related field or equivalent work experience.

• 5+ years’ experience in product management

• Demonstrated ability to be an extremely organized system thinker.

• Proficiency in shaping an idea in way that delivers immediate business value beginning with Minimum Viable Product

• Excellence in analytics, independent research, unscripted interviews, and other intel-gathering techniques

• Professionally challenge existing ideas and workflows to ensure optimal outcomes for users

• Curiosity about our clients and products

• Willingness to learn and serve, flexible in adapting to rapid organizational change, receptive of constructive criticism.

• High tolerance for ambiguity, low tolerance for mess; able to create order out of chaos.

• Ability to communicate effectively from a remote working environment.

Extra nice but not required qualities:

• Familiarity with the clinical data stream, in areas adjacent to Data Management and Biostatistics

• Education or qualifications relating to business, programming, data science, health sciences, medical.

description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work-work that changes the world-is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

 

THE ROLE

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM ) for Everpure’s as-a-Service Subscription portfolio-including Evergreen//One, Evergreen//Flex, and Everpure Cloud-you will serve as the premier customer advocate, trusted advisor, and storage subject matter expert across a key portfolio of enterprise accounts . In this role, you will bridge relationships across cross-functional teams (Engineering, Product Management, Finance, Support, and Executive Leadership) to personalize the customer journey and maximize value realization . By translating complex business and technical requirements into actionable account strategies, you will directly safeguard and elevate Everpure’s industry-leading Net Promoter Score . You’ll also play a pivotal role in shaping our digital transformation by helping design the scalable processes, systems, and programs that power our continued global expansion .

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Drive End-to-End Account Ownership & Retention: Lead vital customer lifecycle activities-including onboarding, adoption, consumption optimization, advocacy, and renewals-to secure maximum value realization and long-term customer satisfaction .

• Conduct Strategic & Operational Reviews: Establish and deliver monthly and quarterly business reviews (MBOs/QBRs) to align technology roadmaps, capacity planning, hardware utilization, and expansion opportunities across key enterprise stakeholders, partners, and internal leadership .

• Champion Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the central conduit between the customer and cross-functional teams (Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Support, and Executive leadership) to streamline communication, mitigate risks, and resolve escalations rapidly .

• Guide Technical & Programmatic Enablement: Act as a subject matter expert for the Everpure Evergreen Subscription program, offering technical recommendations on data center environment utilization, migration strategies, and deployment best practices .

• Build Scalable Customer Success Operations: Contribute to internal initiatives, programs, and tools that enhance operational effectiveness, refine post-sales service delivery models, and support Everpure's scaling business lines .

WHAT YOU BRING

• Experience: 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing, account management role and 2+ years experience in a Customer Success role/

• Customer Success & Technical Account Expertise: Proven success in customer-facing account management or customer success roles within enterprise IT, data center environments, or SaaS/as-a-Service platforms, with a strong ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder relationships .

• Technical Communication & Strategic Problem Solving: Ability to articulate technical storage and data center concepts clearly to both technical engineers and executive-level audiences, connecting technical capabilities directly to business outcomes .

• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Escalation Management: Demonstrated track record of orchestrating internal resources across engineering, support, sales, and executive teams to navigate critical escalations, execute account action plans, and drive joint growth initiatives .

• Adaptability & Continuous Improvement: Ability to exercise independent judgment and thrive in a fast-paced environment by helping define, refine, and operationalize processes within evolving business functions .

title: Recruiting Marketing Project Coordinator
description:
About the Role
Are you the person who can turn a scattered set of comments, files, and next steps into a finished project? We’d love to meet you.
At Ami Arroyo, Inc. , we believe great recruiting starts with people and is strengthened by precision. We want our website and content to reflect that same care. We’re looking for a Marketing Project Coordinator who can keep website updates and landing-page work moving from an agreed goal through an approved, verified launch.
You’ll work with our founder, our copywriter, AI-assisted design tools, and our developer. Your role is to bring structure, clarity, and follow-through to the process, so the right work gets to the right person, decisions are easy to make, and nothing stops at “almost done.”
What You'll Own

• Keep projects moving. Turn agreed deliverables into clear tasks, owners, due dates, dependencies, and next steps. Follow up on stalled handoffs and flag blockers early.

• Make the brief usable. Gather page goals, audience, offer, visitor action, approved evidence, and assets. Surface missing information before it creates rework.

• Coordinate content. Organize existing copy and creative assets, request missing inputs, consolidate feedback, and track the correct working and approved versions.

• Connect design and development. Coordinate Manus AI design outputs, annotated revisions, developer questions, and approved materials without losing context.

• Prepare decisions for Ami. Bring a concise review packet with the exact version, completed checks, open questions, your recommendation, and approval needed.

• Check the work through launch. Review content and mobile layout, test links and forms using test data, track corrections, confirm approval, and verify the live result.

• Keep improvements organized. Maintain a prioritized website-update backlog and report completed milestones, outstanding issues, and upcoming decisions.

What You'll Bring

• Experience coordinating website or content projects, marketing operations, agency accounts, or creative and technical handoffs.

• Follow-through and organization. Own deadlines, priorities, blockers, handoffs, and version history without repeated reminders.

• Strong professional written and spoken English. Turn scattered input into clear instructions, focused questions, and approval requests.

• Editorial and visual judgment. Spot outdated claims, inconsistent calls to action, and mobile or readability issues.

• Web workflow literacy. Check pages, links, and forms, and describe issues clearly to the developer.

• Dependable remote work habits, independent task management, and agreed overlap for U.S.-team reviews and handoffs.

• Sound judgment with AI-assisted work. Verify facts and approved messaging, protect information, and respect approval boundaries.

Experience That's Helpful
U.S.-team experience, website launches, project trackers, and AI-assisted design tools are helpful. Familiarity with Manus AI is a plus, not required. You don’t need to be a designer, developer, or senior copywriter.
What Success Looks Like

• A landing page and a defined batch of website updates are approved, published, and verified.

• Claims are accurate, links and forms work, handoffs are closed.

• We measure finished work and quality for this role.

If you love bringing people, ideas, and details together to turn good work into something great, we'd love to hear from you. At Ami Arroyo, Inc. , every detail is an opportunity to build trust, and we're excited to meet someone who brings creativity, care, and follow-through to the process.

Preferred Qualifications

Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. You are joining our growing AWS practice, focusing on North America growth across multiple industries where you have the unique opportunity to be part of driving the pre-sales motion, and being a key leader in building the delivery standards and support to effective delivery. Across clients in Fortune 1000 and Private-equity backed businesses, you work with Blend experts and Client Development leaders to be a strategic advisor to clients and shape engagements to create real business value. Internally you work across architects and engineers globally to help drive architecture standards, team support and accelerator development.
You are a passionate AWS advocate that loves data and AI - someone who lights up talking about the technology, earns instant credibility with AWS engineers and client architects alike.
Responsibilities
Platform Architecture/Approach Pre-Sales Efforts:

• Partner with Blend Client Partners and Business Development Leaders across North America to drive sales efforts around data platform and AI Application architectures and approach, supporting proposals, workshops, and other sales activities.

• Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, and solution demonstrations that connect client challenges to AWS-based outcomes

• Engage directly with AWS field technical teams (SAs, Specialist SAs) to co-develop solutions and strengthen joint co-sell motions

• Ensure smooth pre-sales to delivery handoffs, maintaining solution integrity and client confidence through the engagement lifecycle, and delivery activities where needed.

Technical Leadership and AWS Community

• Serve as Blend’s primary AWS advocate in North America client-facing engagements, articulating the business and technical value of cloud-native, data, and AI architectures on AWS.

• Work across regions with Blend’s architects and AI Engineers to establish best practices recommendations and help create a community around AWS to provide support to teams and ensure we stay at the cutting edge of AWS approaches.

• Work with appropriate AWS counterparts to align on relevant upskilling and collaboration.

• Contribute to thought leadership through case studies, blog posts, and speaking engagements at AWS and industry events

Executive Presence & GTM Alignment

• You will regularly participate and lead leadership touchpoints within Blend and with AWS

• Frequently lean in with client CTO and CIO’s to whiteboard solution design, and simplify and standardize to communicate complex concepts with confidence to less technical executive audiences

• Apply creative thinking on where is there opportunity for Blend to drive more client value using AWS - translating technical capabilities into business opportunities.

• 15+ years of experience in data or platform architectures, with at least 5 in cloud architecture, solution engineering, or technical pre-sales with a deep focus on AWS

• Strong understanding of AI and deep usage experience.

• Hands-on expertise across core data and AI services including compute, storage, networking, databases, analytics, ML/AI (SageMaker, Bedrock), and serverless

• Strong understanding of real-time and batch architectures and the implications on solution design across analytical and agentic systems.

• Demonstrated ability to work shoulder-to-shoulder with sales teams in a pre-sales or solution engineering capacity

• Strong track record of designing and presenting AWS-based solutions to enterprise audiences at both technical and executive levels

• Experience engaging with AWS field teams and navigating co-sell processes, partner programs, and AWS Marketplace

• Genuine passion for AWS technology and a drive to be a credible, enthusiastic advocate for cloud transformation

• Exceptional communication skills with fluency in both technical architecture discussions and business value storytelling

• AWS certifications required; Solutions Architect Professional or specialty certifications (Data, ML, Security) strong

description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Arquiteto(a) de Soluções especialista em Salesforce Order Management (OMS) para a divisão de Content & Commerce. Essa pessoa vai liderar o desenho técnico e funcional de Salesforce Order Managament para nossos clientes.

• Orientar tecnicamente desenvolvedores, consultores funcionais e tech leads ao longo da entrega, garantindo aderência às boas práticas Salesforce (Flows, Apex, limites de plataforma, segurança e performance).

• Acompanhar o roadmap Salesforce (incluindo Agentforce e evoluções do Commerce e OMS) e propor inovações aos clientes.

• Contribuir para aceleradores, padrões de arquitetura e capacitação interna da prática de OMS.

• Experiência sólida em arquitetura ou consultoria Salesforce, com pelo menos dois projetos de Salesforce Order Management implementados ponta a ponta.

• Conhecimento aprofundado do modelo de dados e dos processos do OMS (Order Summary, Fulfillment Order, Change Orders, Return Orders, Invoices, Payment Summaries).

• Experiência com OCI e com cenários de distributed order management.

• Domínio de integrações (REST/SOAP, eventos, Platform Events, Change Data Capture) e de padrões de arquitetura de integração.

• Conhecimento prático de Flow, Apex e das limitações de plataforma (governor limits, volume de dados, assincronismo).

• Vivência em processos de varejo e e-commerce: pedido, pagamento, estoque, logística e pós-venda.

• Experiência com clientes de médio e grande porte e capacidade de se comunicar com executivos e times técnicos.

Informações adicionais

• Certificações Salesforce: Order Management Accredited Professional, Application Architect ou System Architect, B2C Commerce Architect

title: Intermediate Data Engineer
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Data Engineer at GitLab, you'll build, run, and maintain the pipelines and infrastructure that bring data from our enterprise applications, internal systems, and GitLab's software as a service (SaaS) platform into our data platform. Your work will power company reporting, data science, and artificial intelligence (AI) self-service.

You'll own features end to end, from source integration to tested, monitored, documented data ready for use. You'll focus on keeping the platform reliable, secure, and cost-efficient as data volumes and AI usage grow, and making governed data ready for AI tools, agents, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based access. This is an AI-first role: you'll use AI coding agents every day while maintaining high standards for code review and testing. You'll report to the Director, Data Platform.

What you’ll do

• Build, extend, and maintain extract, load, transform (ELT) pipelines from enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Zuora, Zendesk, and Marketo, internal systems, and the GitLab SaaS platform. Integrate data through application programming interfaces (APIs) and event sources such as Snowplow.

• Manage and maintain the infrastructure behind the platform, including SaaS tools such as Snowflake, Fivetran, and Monte Carlo, and self-managed services such as Airflow and Kubernetes.

• Write maintainable, well-tested, performant Python and Structured Query Language (SQL) code that meets our internal standards, and review GitLab team members' merge requests.

• Own day-to-day platform operations: triage and resolve failed pipelines, infrastructure issues, and GitLab team member requests. Use monitoring, service-level agreements (SLAs), data contracts, query and warehouse tuning, and data quality checks to keep the platform reliable and cost-efficient.

• Partner with Analytics Engineers, Data Analysts, Data Scientists, Data Governance, and business partners so data lands in the shape they need for downstream use.

• Use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, OpenCode, GitLab Duo, or similar tools to speed up development, debugging, testing, and documentation without compromising review rigor.

• Apply role-based access control (RBAC) and masking policies to make governed data available to AI tools and agents. Handle data subject to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls, material nonpublic information (MNPI), and personal data safely.

• Ship medium-sized features independently in small, iterative merge requests, and document architecture and runbooks in the handbook.

What You'll Bring

• Professional experience shipping production data pipeli

title: People & Performance Program Manager (Remote - Mexico)

Kasa is the leading tech-enabled hotel and apartment hotel brand and manager. We partner with owners of multifamily and boutique hospitality properties to deliver stylish, professionally managed accommodations to business and leisure travelers alike. We took the best that hotels and short-term rentals had to offer and created a new class of hospitality that is well-priced, reliable, and offers a large selection of great locations.

Unlike traditional hotel operators, we prioritize automation, AI-driven pricing, and data-driven decision-making to optimize revenue and improve guest experiences. Behind the scenes, we build technology that combines with our innovative operations to grow a globally scalable offering that delivers high-quality stays to guests. Our guests enjoy seamless check-ins, caring service, and attractive amenities - and if anything comes up, our on-site and remote guest experience team is available throughout their stay, ensuring our hospitality is rarely seen but always felt.

Role Overview

Kasa is seeking a People Program Manager to own a defined and evolving slate of People programs, including but not limited to performance scorecards, manager training and enablement, career tracks, the annual performance cycle, and engagement measurement. This role translates strategic organizational priorities into practical, well-run programs.

This role sits within Kasa’s People team and reports to the Director of People & Performance. It’s an individual contributor, program-ownership role: hands-on, analytically strong, and comfortable building repeatable systems end to end. This People Program Manager will work closely with our Senior People Business Partner, and the two roles are intended to work in close partnership with clear swim lanes. The priorities of this role are to:

• Build programs that run without being chased. Own the systems behind how we evaluate, develop, and grow people, and use AI and automation to keep them repeatable and scalable.

• Equip managers to lead well. Give our people managers the tools and training to coach their teams, give useful feedback, and grow talent.

• Give leaders a clear view of team health. Turn People data into insights and recommendations that help us spot trends and retention risks early and act on them.

Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

Performance Scorecards & Manager Enablement

• Build performance scorecards that give managers ongoing visibility into team health and impact

• Design and run manager training and enablement programs that help managers set clear expectations, coach their teams, and grow as leaders

• Build manager capability through training, resources, and job aids on the performance process

Career Tracks

• Own the career tracks framework end-to-end, including leveling, competencies, and progression criteria across functions

• Partner with functional leaders to define what good looks like at each level and keep tracks current as roles and the org evolve

• Make progression transparent for employees through clear criteria, examples, and self-assessment tools so people know what's next and how to get there

• Connect career tracks to performance, promotion, and compensation decisions so leveling stays consistent and defensible

Performance Review Cycle

• Own the annual performance cycle end-to-end, including timeline, communications, calibration, and tooling

• In partnership with key members of the People team, design the review process itself, including rating scales, self and peer input, and how performance connects to promotion and compensation decisions

• Equip managers and employees with clear guidance, resources, and job aids so the process feels useful rather than administrative

• Measure how the cycle lands through completion rates, quality of feedback, and manager and employee sentiment, then improve it each year

title: Research and Development Engineer in Artificial Intelligence - 12 months contract
description:
Who we are ?
Télécom Paris, part of the IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) and a founding member of the Institut Polytechnique de Paris, is one of France's top 6 general engineering schools.
The mainspring of Télécom Paris is to train, imagine and undertake to design digital models, technologies and solutions for a society and economy that respect people and their environment.

Modern distributed systems are increasingly complex, with multiple interconnected components, services, and autonomous agents interacting in dynamic environments. Ensuring their cybersecurity requires analysing potential attacks, understanding the strategies available to attackers and defenders, and verifying that critical security properties are preserved. Formal verification provides rigorous methods for addressing these challenges, allowing engineers to reason about system behaviours and establish mathematical guarantees. However, applying these techniques to realistic systems remains challenging. Verification problems can involve large state spaces and complex strategic interactions, while constructing formal models and specifying security properties often requires specialised expertise.
The VITAMIN-C (VerIficaTion of A MultI-ageNt system for Cybersecurity) project aims to address these challenges by combining formal verification with artificial intelligence. Building on VITAMIN, an existing modular model-checking platform for multi-agent systems, the project develops methods and tools for analysing cybersecurity properties in distributed and autonomous systems. Attackers and defenders are represented as agents with specific capabilities, objectives, and available actions. Their interactions are analysed using attack graphs, temporal and strategic logics, and model-checking techniques. The project also investigates how AI can improve the efficiency and accessibility of these verification processes.
A central objective of VITAMIN-C is to integrate AI techniques into the verification workflow. On the computational side, AI models will be investigated to guide the exploration of large state spaces and prioritise promising verification strategies. By learning from previously verified models and their associated results, these components can help identify relevant search directions and reduce the computational effort required by verification algorithms. On the usability side, the project explores AI-assisted interfaces that support engineers in constructing formal models and specifying security properties. These interfaces may exploit natural-language processing and large language models to interpret engineering descriptions, suggest formal representations, and assist users throughout the verification process. In both cases, the correctness of verification results remains the responsibility of the underlying formal methods, which validate the outcomes produced or suggested by AI components.
Within this context, the R&D engineer will contribute to the design, implementation, and evaluation of AI techniques for VITAMIN-C. The work will focus on developing AI components for verification guidance, investigating natural-language and LLM-based assistance for formal modelling, and integrating these capabilities into the existing platform. The engineer will also participate in the preparation of training and evaluation datasets, the development of experimental benchmarks, and the assessment of the proposed approaches in terms of effectiveness, computational efficiency, and reliability. The overall objective is to make formal verification more scalable and accessible while preserving the rigorous guarantees provided by the verification framework.

Your main responsibilities will include :

• Carry out R&D work in artificial intelligence for formal verification

• Contribute to the research profile of Télécom Paris and Institut Mines-Télécom

• Measure and report impact for each customer against a baseline: hours saved, turnaround time, error rates, and cost per run

Your Impact at LILA

Your role will involve applying soft matter physics and molecular simulation expertise to accelerate the discovery, optimization, and understanding of complex soft matter systems. You will use coarse-grained and atomistic modeling, mesoscale simulation, analytical theory, and agentic AI systems to investigate polymers, colloids, surfactants, gels, liquid crystals, and formulated fluid systems with direct relevance to commercial applications.

You will work at the intersection of physics-based simulation, AI/ML, and autonomous scientific workflows. The focus is on using computational insight to identify promising formulations and material compositions, explain structure-property relationships, guide optimization campaigns, and help agents reason over simulation and experimental data in scientifically grounded ways. Desired simulation expertise covers atomistic and coarse-grained molecular dynamics, mesoscale approaches such as dissipative particle dynamics, Monte Carlo sampling, and analytical theory including self-consistent field theory, field theoretic simulation, and liquid state theory.

This is a hands-on research role for someone who can connect deep soft matter and molecular simulation expertise with software development and practical scientific impact. You will collaborate with computational scientists, AI researchers, software engineers, and experimental teams to turn simulations, models, and scientific reasoning into robust software, agentic frameworks, and closed-loop scientific workflows.

• Strong Python scientific software development skills; fluency with modern practices including version control, testing, code review, and packaging

• Experience running and automating simulations at scale on HPC or cloud, and integrating computational predictions into experimental or closed-loop optimization workflows

• Good familiarity with agentic AI systems, autonomous scientific workflows, or simulation-aware agents

• Experience building agents that reason over or orchestrate simulation workflows, or coupling simulation to active learning and Bayesian optimization pipelines

• Publication record in soft matter theory and simulation

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
description:
ABOUT US

Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents.

Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services.

All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down.

The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on-call.

ABOUT YOU

You're a senior engineer who wants to own features end to end, not just close tickets. You've built and run production Python services, ideally high-traffic or latency-sensitive ones, and you've been on-call for them. You think in trade-offs: latency versus cost, a quick fix versus a durable one, a new parameter versus a public API customers can't afford to see break. You can take a feature from a rough problem statement to a design, ship it, and then make sure it behaves in production. You're comfortable leading a project with one or two other engineers and helping teammates grow along the way. When a problem is only partly defined, you ask the right questions to pin it down. When you meet an unfamiliar protocol or system, you read the spec and work out how it fits. You change your mind when someone has a better argument, and you still care about your code long after it merges.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Own the design and delivery of features and components in our services.

- Design and evolve public API endpoints with backward compatibility in mind, and contribute to architecture discussions for our services.

- Improve performance and reliability: find latency and failure hotspots, add the observability needed to understand them, and fix them.

- Take an active part in design and code review, and mentor mid-level engineers.

- Work with product, solutions/support, and other engineering teams to understand customer needs and turn them into solid technical solutions

- Take part in on-call for the systems you own, and lead incident response and follow-through when things break.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

TECHNICAL

- Solid experience building and operating backend services in production, ideally high-traffic or low-latency ones.

- Extensive Python knowledge (our primary language).

- Hands-on experience with observability (metrics, logs, traces) and debugging performance issues in live systems.

- Experience designing and evolving public APIs that external customers depend on.

- Experience designing & implementing scal

title: Senior Manager Talent Acquisition - Tech
description:
WE POWER PEOPLE’S PROGRESS.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Talent Acquisition at Preply is a high-performing, ambitious team, deeply embedded in the business. We’re intentional about raising the bar: we iterate, use data, test new ideas, and learn together so we can hire the people who will help Preply keep powering progress.

We’re technology-driven, data-informed, and focused on hiring against business priorities and outcomes. Just as importantly, we’re team-first: collaborative, supportive, low-ego, and committed to building something meaningful together.

Building a legendary company should be fun.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

As Preply continues to scale, Engineering remains at the core of our product, growth, and future. We're expanding technical hiring across complex domains and global tech hubs - and we're looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager - Tech to help us build a hiring engine that can match that ambition.

This is a hands-on management role. You'll directly manage a team of TA Partners with full reporting lines, while also personally owning complex engineering searches. You'll stay close to the craft, but your impact will go beyond individual roles: you'll help turn workforce plans into clear hiring priorities, translate those priorities into smart hiring strategies, and build the processes that allow us to hire exceptional talent with speed, quality, and focus.

You'll partner closely with TA Leadership, Engineering Directors, VPs, and our CTO to understand what the business needs, where the biggest hiring bets are, and how we should sequence work across domains and hubs. You'll own the full hiring rhythm: planning, sourcing strategy, pipeline health, calibration, weekly progress tracking, issue-spotting, and continuous improvement.

It's a great fit for someone who has already managed a tech recruitment function and team, and wants to grow within an environment that moves and scales fast, and holds a genuinely high quality bar.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- Own the Engineering hiring engine end to end: understand and collaborate on workforce plans, clarify hiring priorities, translate them into hiring strategies, and make sure the team is set up to deliver against business needs.

- Directly manage a team of TA Partners: full ownership of their performance, development, clear direction and priorities, coaching on search strategy and stakeholder management, and unblocking execution where needed.

- Drive hiring outcomes across technical domains and hubs: take accountability for progress, quality, and delivery across Engineering hiring in our main hubs Barcelona, London and Kyiv, while personally owning a couple of complex and high-impact searches.

- Build and optimize hiring processes: identify what slows us down, where quality drops, or where ownership is unclear - then improve the process so we can hire top talent in the most effective way.

- Track progress through data: run a strong weekly hiring rhythm, using funnel data, pipeline quality, pass-through rates, time in stage, sourcing performance, and stakeholder feedback to understand what's working and what needs to change.

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement - built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Mobile App team, you will help design and build Zip's first mobile application. It's a brand-new app, the first for Zip, built by a new team within our engineering organization. Mobile is where Zip meets people away from their desks: approving a purchase between meetings, checking on a request, or ordering supplies on a warehouse floor.

- Élaborer les politiques : Développer et déployer nos politiques et traitements de comptabilité des revenus en documentant les positions selon une norme prête pour l'audit et en assurant la cohérence dans toute l'organisation.

Rust Engineer - Trading Systems

At Keyrock , we're not just envisioning the future of digital assets. We're actively building it.

We are seeking a Senior Rust Engineer with deep trading systems experience and strong AWS knowledge to join our core Capital Markets division. Candidates with a passion for the Rust ecosystem and a proven track record designing, building, and operating mission-critical trading systems will be at a significant advantage.
As part of the engineering team in Capital Markets, you will take ownership of high-impact trading infrastructure, set technical direction in your domain, and drive continuous improvement in system performance, reliability, and operability. Job description

• Design, develop, and optimise low-latency, mission-critical trading systems

• Own key trading stack components end-to-end - from architecture through to production operation

• Collaborate closely with quants, traders, and engineers to deliver solutions that improve trading performance and resilience

• Maintain and evolve trading infrastructure with a focus on performance, stability, observability, and operational excellence

• Troubleshoot complex production issues across exchange connectivity, execution, and market data handling

• Drive engineering standards through technical leadership, code reviews, and mentoring

• Contribute to functional, component, and production-readiness testing for critical trading components

Background and experience

• Proficiency in Python or other scripting languages for strategy development, automation, and operational tooling

• Deep familiarity with trading system protocols ( FIX , REST , WebSocket ), exchange connectivity, and market data feeds

• Solid grasp of low-latency networking: TCP / UDP , packet and latency path analysis, dedicated network infrastructure, and kernel bypass techniques ( DPDK )

Energy Program
Union of Concerned Scientists
Remote
Bargaining Unit Position: Yes
Our Organization
The Union of Concerned Scientists (UCS) is an independent nonprofit that puts rigorous, independent science into action, developing solutions and advocating for a healthy, safe, and just future. We envision a peaceful, healthy, and just world where science serves people and the planet by guiding policy decisions, reducing risks, and improving lives.
For over five decades, we have been working as scientists, engineers, economists, advocates, and everyday people to create and advocate for innovative, practical solutions to some of our planet’s most pressing problems-from combating global warming and developing sustainable ways to feed, power, and transport ourselves, to fighting disinformation, advancing racial equity, and reducing the threat of nuclear war. Values informing our work include:

• Science in the service of people and the planet.

• Justice and Equity for people of all races and incomes-now, and for future generations.

• Courage to take principled, science-based stands in the public arena.

• Integrity to always examine evidence critically, openly, and honestly.

• Democracy to promote a voice for all in government decisions.

• Action inspiring and mobilizing people to build a healthier, safer, and more just world.

The Position
The Analyst will represent UCS as a key stakeholder before one or more Regional Transmission Organizations/Independent System Operators (RTO/ISOs), tackling critical priority issues. The focus will be on promoting data-driven and forward-looking transmission system planning, advancing energy market structures that accurately reflect the contributions of clean energy resources, and fostering inclusive decision-making processes that drive equitable outcomes. This will involve direct engagement with RTO/ISO staff and leadership, active participation in stakeholder meetings, and collaboration with a diverse range of stakeholders to build consensus on vital issues. The analyst may also engage with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) as matters progress from RTO/ISO deliberation to FERC approvals.
The Analyst will provide thought leadership and technical support to further the mission of UCS's Energy Program. They will contribute to developing Theories of Change, design research objectives and strategies, and critically evaluate empirical evidence. They will represent UCS's values in science advocacy initiatives and engage in research and analysis related to current or potential policy decisions in mission-critical areas.
Additionally, the Analyst will provide subject-matter expertise on bulk electric system issues, supporting teams across the UCS Energy Program, including federal policy and state advocacy units. They will play a vital role in designing and implementing analyses that align with UCS’s advocacy efforts and strategic priorities.
Finally, the Analyst will actively elevate UCS's positions through various communication channels, including blogs, web content, media interviews, and social media, ensuring our messages reach and resonate with a wide audience.

description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands - including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank - to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Sierra was co-founded by Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/ who first met while working together at Google over 20 years ago. Bret currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Open AI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce and CTO of Facebook. Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Every Sierra voice agent sits inside a customer’s phone network, from Uber and Rivian to Santander, SoFi, and Singapore Airlines. Before a deal closes, the customer's telephony, network, and security teams must know how calls will reach the agent, how calls will return to their contact center, and what they must change on their side. You will be the person who answers those questions. You will sit on the Channels team, with the engineers who build Sierra's telephony stack, and you will work with Sales and Agent Engineering on our largest deals and customer deployments.

- Lead telephony conversations in sales and implementation cycles. Run discovery on the customer's carriers, session border controllers, IVR, voice networks, and contact centers. Draw their topology, and recommend how to connect it to Sierra.

- Design the integration. Choose between SIP trunking, PSTN, and websocket audio connections for each customer. Explain the trade-offs to their architects. Cover inbound calls, outbound calls, transfers to human agents, and the context that goes with each transfer.

- Get security and network reviews approved. Give the customer's firewall and telephony teams the specifications they need: IP ranges, ports, TLS and SRTP requirements, codecs, authentication options, and SIP header behavior. Answer their follow-up questions accurately and quickly.

- Solve the hard cases. Bring-your-own-carrier, private network interconnects, on-premises contact centers, data residency rules, and international calling each change the design. You will work out what is possible and tell the customer plainly.

- Stay on the hard deployments. Most customers go to the account's Agent Engineer once the first test call connects. The hard ones stay with you: bring-your-own-carrier setups, private interconnects, on-premises contact centers. You help bring up the trunk. When calls drop, audio goes one way, or transfers lose their context, you read the packet captures, find the cause, and fix it, whether it's on their side or ours.

- Build new capabilities with design partners. When a customer needs something we don't support yet, like a new transfer method, a custom SIP header mapping, or a new carrier, you work with them and Channels engineering. You spec it, test it against their real network, and get it into the product.

- Make the answers reusable. Write the reference architectures, diagrams, setup guides, and customer-ready decks that let Sales Engineers and Agent Engineers handle routine integrations without you.

- Bring what you learn back to the product. You will see every gap in our telephony and contact-center integrations first. Turn those gaps into clear requirements for Channels engineering and product.

- Work with contact-center and carrier partners. Build direct relationships with their technical teams so that mutual customers get one consistent answer.

title: Retail Credit Risk Senior Specialist
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

About the Team

The Credit Risk Squad is part of the 2nd line of defense, responsible for managing and overseeing the credit risk function of our organization by providing independent oversight and challenge to the first line of defense. Within it, the Provisions team creates the Expected Credit Loss (ECL) models used to calculate loss allowances, participating end to end in model development, implementation, monitoring, data quality and support to Finance accounting teams. Our models feed Nubank's financial statements under IFRS 9 and local regulation, including CMN Resolution 4,966/2021 and BCB Resolution 352/2023 in Brazil.

About the Role

As a Retail Credit Risk Senior Specialist focused on Brazil, you'll be the focal point for everything related to Res. 4966 expected credit loss provisioning. You'll proactively identify and control gaps in the models and in the processes built around them, from inputs and model implementation to closing and regulatory reporting. That means making sure models comply with regulatory expectations, produce the correct data for accounting and regulatory reports, and that ECL movements are understood, controlled and well explained.

You'll also be a primary point of contact for the local regulator (BCB) and the external auditors (KPMG) on the local models, working alongside the team's leadership. This is an individual-contributor role with high visibility among senior stakeholders in Finance, Risk and the local CRO's office.

YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Own the Res. 4966 ECL provisioning chain - be the team's focal point on the local models, monthly closing and the data they produce for accounting and regulatory reports.

- Identify and close gaps proactively - assess models and surrounding processes (inputs, implementation, closing, reporting) against regulatory expectations, and drive the plan to close them.

- Explain and control ECL movements - make sure monthly provision movements are understood, controlled and clearly explained to the Global Credit Director and the BR local CRO.
